HUMAN QA CAUGHT A REAL DEFECT the agent pass missed. On the current month BOTH bars rendered red, so the legend (one swatch per dataset) was wrong for that month. Cause: makeDataset() defaults every colour to generateColors(), a PER-MONTH array that applies DEV-2324's current-month highlight; the Total series took that default while Unique passed an explicit accent, so in the highlighted month Total was repainted accent too. Fix: withStaticSeriesColors() in SharedHitStatsData flattens both datasets to one stable colour each (Total = static grey, Unique = accent), dropping the month highlight for these four widgets only — exactly what prep predicted and what round-1 review flagged as an unimplemented design implication. Added a regression test asserting every colour key is a scalar, not a per-month array, and that the two series differ; verified it FAILS on the pre-fix code. Tests after: 29 + 85 + 217 green. Files: SharedHitStatsData.php, DashboardCardMetricsTest.php.
